# [CS047] Blocking Call While Holding a Mutex (lock-blocking-io)

A sync.Mutex or RWMutex is held across a network call or sleep.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Reliability & Concurrency |
| **CWE** | [CWE-833](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/833.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Every goroutine that needs the lock waits for the slowest remote call made under it; with a deferred Unlock the lock is held until the function returns. Copy what you need, unlock, then do the I/O.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
c.mu.Lock()
defer c.mu.Unlock()
resp, err := c.client.Get(c.url) // other goroutines wait for the network
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
c.mu.Lock()
url := c.url
c.mu.Unlock()
resp, err := c.client.Get(url)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [lock-blocking-io]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    lock-blocking-io: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore lock-blocking-io -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** lock-blocking-io
```
